$comment: Origin Trial tokens for https://the40thieves.dev (O-13, P3-S4). Tokens are public: the layout prints each live one as <meta http-equiv="origin-trial">. One entry per browser trial: { "browser": "chrome" | "edge", "token": "<the token string from the trial page>" }. apps/hub/src/lib/origin-trials.ts decodes them; a token for another origin fails apps/hub/tests/origin-trials.test.ts and an expired one is dropped at build time. With no entry the WebMCP page tools never load. Only WebMCP tokens belong here: the page gate treats any printed token as the WebMCP switch.
